caption: The drawing depicts a dark-colored, likely black, triangular shawl or mantle draped with the point facing downward. The fabric features intricate embroidered floral and vine patterns concentrated in the central and upper areas, with additional curved vine designs along the upper edge. The shawl is bordered on all sides by long, straight fringes, with the fringe being most prominent along the lower edge. The drawing is done in a realistic style, and the shawl occupies the center of the composition. On the left and right lower corners, there are two faint pencil sketches that appear to be alternative views or additional garments, both with similar decorative edging, presented in a less detailed manner. The background is a plain, light color, possibly beige or cream, and there is handwritten text below the drawing, reading "Westchester County" on the left and "drawn by I. Mc Strange" on the right.
title: Shawl
